Auth.title: Sign in to OrgTik
Auth.subtitle: One account for every app in your workspace.
Auth.passwordMin: Your password has at least 8 characters.
Auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account. Check them and try again.
Auth.validationFailed: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
Auth.failed: Couldn't sign in. Check your connection and try again.
Auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
Auth.accountReady: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email and the password you chose.

AuthShell.tagline: Every app in your workspace, one sign-in.

Feedback.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
Feedback.readOnly: You're viewing as someone else, so changes are turned off.
Feedback.gone: This item no longer exists. Refresh the page to see the latest.
Feedback.conflict: This is already in use (often a name or an email). Change it and try again.
Feedback.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
Feedback.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Feedback.invalid: Some details aren't valid. Check them and try again.

Errors.crashBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or go back home.
Errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the page may have moved.
Errors.noAccessTitle: You don't have access to this page
Errors.noAccessBody: It's for suite administrators. Ask one if you need it.

Nav.actingAsBy: Started from {name}'s account. You can look around; changes are turned off, and this visit is recorded.

People.title: People
People.description: Everyone with an OrgTik account, and the tools they can open.
People.noMatchBody: Try another search, or clear the filters to see everyone.
People.emptyBody: Add the first person, then give them access to the tools they need.
People.deactivateImpact: {name} is signed out of every tool and can't sign in until you activate the account again. Their access and data stay as they are.
People.deleteImpact: {name} loses access to every tool at once, and their account is removed from People. To keep the account but stop access, deactivate it instead.
People.loginAsImpact: You'll see SOS and the tools exactly as {name} does, read-only: nothing can be changed. The visit is recorded under your name. Use “Stop viewing” in the banner to return.
People.typeBody: The type decides what {name} sees in some tools, such as the CRM.

Person.addBody: They can sign in with this email and password, and open the tools you choose.
Person.editBody: Only what you change is saved.
Person.passwordKeep: Leave it empty to keep the current password.
Person.toolsHelp: Choose roles in each tool afterwards, from Manage access.
Person.canSignInHelp: Untick to create the account without letting them sign in yet.

Access.title: {name}'s access
Access.description: The tools this person can open, and their role in each.
Access.addToolBody: {name} can open it from the launcher right away. Choose their roles in it next.
Access.noToolsLeft: {name} already has access to every active tool.
Access.rolesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No roles} one {# role} other {# roles}}
Access.noRoles: No role yet: they can open the tool, but some parts may stay closed.
Access.noRolesLeft: Every role in {tool} is already given.
Access.addRoles: {count, plural, =0 {Add roles} one {Add # role} other {Add # roles}}
Access.removeToolImpact: {name} can no longer open {tool}, and {count, plural, =0 {has no roles there} one {their # role there is removed} other {their # roles there are removed}}.
Access.removeRoleImpact: {name} keeps access to {tool}, but can no longer do what {role} allows. You can add it back at any time.
Access.noAccessBody: Give them access to the tools they need, then choose their roles.
Access.notFoundBody: The account may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

Recovery.forgotBody: Enter your work email. If it has an account, we'll send a code to set a new password.
Recovery.sendFailed: The code couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
Recovery.resetBody: Enter the code from the email we sent you, and choose a new password.
Recovery.resetBodyKnown: If <email>x</email> has an account, we sent it a code. Enter it below with your new password.
Recovery.codeRequired: Enter the code from the email.
Recovery.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest email, or send a new code.
Recovery.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
Recovery.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s
Recovery.resetFailed: The password couldn't be changed. Try again.

Invite.reviewBodyBy: {name} invited you to OrgTik. Check your details, then choose a password.
Invite.reviewBody: You're invited to OrgTik. Check your details, then choose a password.
Invite.passwordBody: You'll sign in with {email} and this password.
Invite.acceptFailed: Your account couldn't be activated. Try again.
Invite.alreadyAccount: There's already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
Invite.signedInBody: You're signed in as {name}. To accept this invitation for another account, sign out first.
Invite.missingBody: Open the full link from your invitation email, or ask whoever invited you to send it again.
Invite.invalidBody: The link may be mistyped, or the invitation was withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
Invite.usedBody: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email and password.
Invite.expiredBodyBy: Ask {name} to send you a new one.
Invite.expiredBody: Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
Invite.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.

Redirecting.noAccessTitle: There's no customer area for this account
Redirecting.noAccessBody: Sign in with the account your OrgTik contact set up for you.
Redirecting.notConfiguredTitle: The customer area isn't available right now
Redirecting.notConfiguredBody: It isn't set up yet on our side. Try again later, or ask your OrgTik contact.
Redirecting.failedTitle: Your customer area couldn't be opened
Redirecting.failedBody: Check your connection, then sign in again.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.description: How you appear across OrgTik, your preferences and your password.
Profile.photoHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. People see it next to your name in every tool.
Profile.photoType: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
Profile.photoSize: That image is over 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
Profile.detailsHelp: Your name and role, as colleagues see them.
Profile.emailHelp: You sign in with it. To change it, ask a suite administrator.
Profile.languageHelp: SOS switches at once; the other tools follow the next time you open them.
Profile.timeZoneHelp: Dates and times are shown in it.
Profile.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. You stay signed in here.
Profile.passwordFailed: The password couldn't be changed. Try again.

Systems.title: Systems
Systems.pageDescription: The suite's apps and the client websites people sign in to through SOS.
Systems.addTitle: Add an app to the suite
Systems.dialogBody: People given access open it from the launcher.
Systems.name: Name
Systems.addressHelp: Where the app runs, starting with https://
Systems.iconHelp: An Iconify id, used by apps still on the older launcher.
Systems.urlInvalid: Enter a full address, like https://app.orgtik.ch
Systems.turnOffImpact: Nobody can open {name} from the launcher until you turn it on again. People keep their access and roles, so nothing has to be set up again.
Systems.emptyApps: No apps in the suite yet

Cms.dialogBody: A client's website that SOS signs people in to.
Cms.name: Name
Cms.accountsBody: The CMS accounts SOS signs in with, and who uses each.
Cms.deleteImpact: {name}, its accounts and their member lists are removed from SOS, and nobody can open the site from here any more. The website itself isn't changed.
Cms.emptyBody: Add a client's website to let your team open it signed in.
Cms.accountDialogBody: The sign-in SOS uses on the client's CMS.
Cms.passwordKeep: Leave it empty to keep the current password. It's never shown.
Cms.passwordNew: The CMS account's password. It's stored, never shown.
Cms.membersCount: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
Cms.openAs: Open the CMS as this account
Cms.openFailed: The CMS couldn't be opened. Try again.
Cms.deleteAccountImpact: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody uses this account yet.} one {The # person who uses it can no longer open {name} from SOS.} other {The # people who use it can no longer open {name} from SOS.}} The account on the CMS itself isn't changed.
Cms.noAccountsBody: Add the CMS sign-in your team should use.
Cms.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
Cms.membersBody: These people can open the CMS as this account.
Cms.removeMemberImpact: {name} can no longer open the CMS as {account}. You can add them back at any time.

Websites.title: Websites
Websites.description: The client websites you manage. Each opens signed in.
Websites.openFailed: The website couldn't be opened. Try again, or ask an administrator to check your access.
Websites.emptyBody: When an administrator adds a client CMS and gives you an account on it, it appears here.

Home.title: Welcome, {name}
Home.description: Open any of your apps from here or from the rail on the side.
Home.noAppsBody: Ask a suite administrator to give you access to the apps you need.

Open.notYoursBody: It isn't one of your apps, or it's turned off. Ask a suite administrator if you need it.
